description: Submit artwork for the artist bounty program. Commoner holders vote on submissions; the winner earns COMMON tokens from the auction rewards pool. Both human-created and AI-generated work are explicitly welcome. Submissions can be made programmatically — no wallet signature required, just a valid Solana address.

date.description: Auction date this submission is for (YYYY-MM-DD format)

imageUrl.description: Public URL to the artwork image

solanaAddress.description: Solana wallet address to receive any COMMON rewards

type.description: Whether the work is human-created or AI-assisted

name: submit_bounty
